      "observations": [
        "All 671 selected diff lines across 14 Thunderbird/shared paths were read. The complete 15-path metadata includes one Suite path whose body and Suite-only review threads remain excluded. Sync stop carries parallel message-key/header arrays; the queue retains header blocks for header-only filters and can store null while waiting for full body download. Common ApplyFilters validates nonempty array alignment before dispatch. Existing NUL-buffer and alignment analysis is reused.",
        "The executor converts supplied fields to NUL-delimited name/value entries for MatchHdr. Failed count/name/value calls are skipped, so partial header input can reach matching; no new fallback or error propagation is inferred. The nested retrieval loop could use a small checked-field append helper to make its continuation policy clearer. That is a scoped readability suggestion, not a formatter finding or behavior change.",
        "The local RefPtr owns MsgOperationListener before calling fallible ApplyFilters. The service has early exits before creating its executor, while the executor later retains the callback in a strong nsCOMPtr. The source establishes the ownership path; no leak experiment was run.",
        "The new test disables autosync, creates 20 fake messages, gives half the arbitrary Made-Up-Header and checks that half remain unread after filtering. Its total-count assertion has no message, already covered by an existing focused lesson. Five added C++ array-invariant assertions also omit messages. The fake server excludes only exact To/From names and documents incomplete real-server modeling; this test is not server conformance or body-required branch coverage.",
        "All changed Thunderbird manual/archive/outgoing filter callers pass an empty header list. The IDL allows an empty list or an aligned list with null entries. The explicit root-folder sync in test setup and the later accepted Exchange path names are retained as separate source phases. No filter, protocol, UI, native build or test execution ran.",
        "Full primary 2014905 and the complete Thunderbird/shared D283190 scope were read. Six actual inlines and one replacement are retained. The original collector excluded two Suite-only inline IDs by path metadata before body capture; those bodies were not read here. Initial landing, explicit backout and this tweaked reland remain separate; author good-Try and remote completion are historical reports.",
        "The callback-ownership request is adopted: the caller creates a local RefPtr before fallible dispatch, and the inspected executor owns the callback later. This supports the focused new ownership lesson without a fresh leak experiment. The nsACString proposal is rebutted because the API expects an abstract interface while nsCString supplies storage; landed code keeps its concrete NUL-containing buffer. This is the exact MatchHdr contract, not a blanket string preference.",
        "The suggested common setup helper is present, but explicit root sync remains in the task before looking up Inbox. The author explains protocol-specific implicit sync and leaves the general cross-protocol setup unresolved. No universal setup pattern or actual server behavior follows from this fake-server case.",
        "New invariant assertions still lack messages and the total-count test message gap reuses its existing lesson. The test waits for any unread-count change before checking exactly half; no fresh scheduling, full-body filtering, invalid-array or per-action-completion experiment was run. The selected source proofs preserve all 14 eligible paths and every explicit Suite exclusion."
